claims.claim_text: The Hugging Face Hub now holds almost 300 TB of open Physical AI data in LeRobot format, according to the LeRobot v0.7.0 release post.
claims.excerpt: The Hub now holds almost 300 TB of open Physical AI data in LeRobot format, with some of the largest datasets released in just the past few months.

claims.claim_text: LeRobot v0.7.0 adds --interactive=true to lerobot-rollout, which keeps the robot connection, policy weights and processors loaded between instructions.
claims.excerpt: Add --interactive=true to lerobot-rollout, and the robot connection, policy weights and processors stay loaded between instructions.

claims.claim_text: With lerobot-policy-server, the model can run on a GPU workstation elsewhere in the lab while the robot's laptop or single-board computer handles cameras and motors.
claims.excerpt: With lerobot-policy-server, you can keep a laptop or single-board computer beside the robot and run the model on a GPU workstation across the lab.

claims.claim_text: Cosmos 3 Nano and Cosmos 3 Edge reach 97.90% and 97.95% average success on LIBERO, according to the release post.
claims.excerpt: It comes in two sizes, Cosmos 3 Nano (16.5B parameters) and Cosmos 3 Edge (4.6B), which reach 97.90% and 97.95% average success on LIBERO.

claims.claim_text: LingBot-VLA 2.0 reports 93.5% success on RoboTwin 2.0 (clean), against 82.7% for π0.5, according to upstream reporting cited by LeRobot.
claims.excerpt: Upstream, it reports 93.5% success on RoboTwin 2.0 (clean), against 82.7% for π0.5.

claims.claim_text: The LaWAM LIBERO fine-tune scores 98.5%, which the release post says is 1,970 of 2,000 episodes.
claims.excerpt: the LIBERO fine-tune scores 98.5% (1,970 of 2,000 episodes).

claims.claim_text: In LeRobot, ACT trains 2.8x faster on an H100 and 3.3x faster on an A100 when image augmentation runs on the GPU.
claims.excerpt: ACT trains 2.8x faster on an H100 and 3.3x faster on an A100.

claims.claim_text: The G0.5 code and weights are released under the non-commercial G0.5 Community License, not Apache-2.0.
claims.excerpt: G0.5's code and weights are released under the non-commercial G0.5 Community License, not Apache-2.0.
